lastRequest: Build a simple fullstack Todo app with Express REST API, Prisma SQLite database, and a React frontend with dark mode, task creation, completion toggle, and delete.

tasks.title: Database Schema & Validation Setup
tasks.description: Define Prisma Task model with SQLite and build shared Zod validation schemas for task entities.

tasks.title: Backend Express REST API Development
tasks.description: Implement Express server, repository layer, and controllers for task CRUD, filtering, search, bulk delete, and export endpoints.

tasks.title: Frontend Client API & State Management
tasks.description: Build Axios client layer, custom React hooks for optimistic updates with Sonner toasts, and theme management logic.

tasks.title: Frontend Components & Feature UI
tasks.description: Construct Tailwind-styled UI components for task management, filter/search controls, dark mode, and CSV/JSON export.

tasks.title: Dockerization & Build Validation
tasks.description: Configure multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose, and perform full end-to-end production build and runtime validation.
